title: 11 March 1969: Mixing: Two Of Us, The Long And Winding Road, Lady Madonna
content:
Olympic Sound Studios, Barnes, London
Producer: George Martin
Engineer: Glyn Johns

This was the second mixing session for the unreleased Get Back album, which Glyn Johns had been asked to compile by John Lennon and Paul McCartney early in March 1969.

Stereo mixes of three songs from the January 1969 Get Back/Let It Be recording sessions at Apple Studios were made on this day at London’s Olympic Sound Studios. They were of ‘Two Of Us’, ‘The Long And Winding Road’, and ‘Lady Madonna’.
